title: Serre vanishing for a finite graded module on a proper scheme
statement: Let $A$ be Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], and let $B=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}B_n$ be a finitely generated graded commutative $A$-algebra (graded-algebra convention as in [def-pc-standard-graded-algebra]). Let $\widetilde B$ be the quasi-coherent algebra associated to $B$ [def-weil-pbc-associated-module] and put $\mathcal B=f^*\widetilde B$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. If $\mathcal G$ is a finite type [pqf-def-coherent] graded quasi-coherent $\mathcal B$-module, and $\mathcal L$ is an ample [def-sc-ample] invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module] on $X$, then there is $d_0$ such that $H^p(X,\mathcal G\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes d})=0$ for all $p>0$ and $d\ge d_0$, where $H^p$ is sheaf cohomology [pqf-def-cohomology].

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 0897 (lemma-graded-finiteness), part (2), using Properties Proposition 01Q3 (properties-proposition-characterize-ample), proper pushforward finiteness, and the Serre vanishing argument
